info.description:
You can interact with FanarAPI for seamless chat completion and text processing using Fanar.
Base URL: https://api.fanar.qa
Request API Access: https://api.fanar.qa/request

Rate Limits

To ensure fair usage and optimal performance for all users, our API has rate limits in place. When you exceed a rate limit, your request will typically receive a 429 Too Many Requests HTTP status code.

Limits by model

These are our default settings for all models. We understand that your needs may vary. If your application requires higher throughput or more tailored rate limits for specific models, please contact us:

Model Rate Limit
Fanar 50 requests/minute
Fanar-S-1-7B 50 requests/minute
Fanar-C-1-8.7B 50 requests/minute
Fanar-C-2-27B 50 requests/minute
Fanar-2.0-Tools 50 requests/minute
Fanar-Sadiq 50 requests/minute
Fanar-Sadiq-2 50 requests/minute
Fanar-Sadiq-2 (validate) 200 requests/minute
Fanar-Sadiq-2 (deep research) 20 requests/day
Fanar-Sadiq-TTS-1 20 requests/day
Fanar-Oryx-IVU-2 20 requests/day
Fanar-Aura-TTS-2 20 requests/day
Fanar-Aura-STT-1 (deprecated) 20 requests/day
Fanar-Aura-STT-LF-1 (deprecated) 10 requests/day
Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe 50 requests/day
Fanar-3.0-Aura-Diarize 50 requests/day
Fanar-Oryx-IG-2 20 requests/day
Fanar-Guard-2 50 requests/minute
Fanar-Shaheen-MT-1 (deprecated) 20 requests/day
Fanar-3.0-Shaheen-Translate 20 requests/day
Fanar-Diwan 50 requests/minute
Response headers

Every rate-limited response reports your current quota, so you can back off before being throttled:

Header Description
x-ratelimit-limitRequests allowed per window.
x-ratelimit-remainingRequests still available in the current window.
x-ratelimit-resetSeconds until a request slot frees up.
ratelimit-policyThe quota and its window in seconds, as limit;w=seconds — so 100;w=86400 means 100 requests per day.
retry-afterSeconds to wait before retrying, sent only on a 429. When your own quota ran out it counts down to a free slot; when an upstream service throttled the request it carries that service's own hint instead.

Because x-ratelimit-limit alone cannot tell 3 per minute from 3 per day, read ratelimit-policy when you need the window. These headers are omitted for API keys with unlimited quota.

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

client = AsyncOpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.fanar.qa/v1",
    api_key="YOUR_API_KEY_HERE",
)

messages = [
    {"role": "user", "content": "Your message here"}
]

stream = await client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Fanar",
    messages=messages,
    stream=True
)

print("Assistant Response:\n")

content = ""
references = None

async for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta:
        delta = chunk.choices[0].delta
        
        # Capture references from the first chunk
        if hasattr(delta, 'references') and delta.references:
            references = delta.references
        
        # Stream content as it arrives
        if delta.content:
            content += delta.content
            print(delta.content, end="", flush=True)

print("\n")

# Print references if present
if references:
    print("\nReferences:")
    for ref in references:
        number = ref.get("number", "-")
        source = ref.get("source", "Unknown source")
        ref_content = ref.get("content", "")
        print(f"\n[{number}] {source}\n{ref_content}")

# Thinking mode requires additional authorization and is not allowed by default.

import requests

def model_api(messages, max_tokens=500):
    headers = {
        "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }

    payload = {
        "model": "Fanar-C-1-8.7B",
        "messages": messages,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
    }

    response = requests.post(
        "https://api.fanar.qa/v1/chat/completions", 
        json=payload, 
        headers=headers
    )
    return response.json()

# Step 1: User message with "thinking_user" role
messages = [
  {"role": "thinking_user", "content": user_input}
]

# Step 2: Send request to model with extended max tokens
response = model_api(
    messages=messages,
    max_tokens=2000,
)

output = response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
finish_reason = response["choices"][0]["finish_reason"]

# Step 3: Check if thinking mode continuation is needed
has_think_tag = "</think>" in output
hit_length_limit = finish_reason == "length"

if has_think_tag or hit_length_limit:
    # Extract thinking output
    thinking_output = output.split("</think>")[0] if has_think_tag else output

    # Modify the last "thinking_user" role message to "user"
    for msg in reversed(messages):
        if msg["role"] == "thinking_user":
            msg["role"] = "user"
            break

    # Add new "thinking" role message with extracted output
    messages.append({"role": "thinking", "content": thinking_output})

    # Re-run model with updated messages, shorter max tokens
    final_response = model_api(
        messages=messages,
        max_tokens=1000,
    )

    final_output = final_response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
else:
    final_output = output

# final_output now contains the full response after handling thinking mode
print("Assistant Response:\n")
print(final_output)

post.description:
This endpoint is compatible with the OpenAI library.
Generates audio from the input text.

200.description: The audio file content or error details.

X-Id.description: A unique identifier for the text-to-speech.

X-Revised-Input.description: The processed input text after Quran and hadith validation and tagging. This header is only present when using the Fanar-Sadiq-TTS model. The validator identifies Quranic verses and hadith in the input; verses are wrapped with XML-style tags (e.g., `<quran_start>`, `<quran_end>`) for proper handling during text-to-speech processing, and corrections such as diacritical marks normalization or verse formatting may be applied. Hadith tags and the markdown reference links the validator adds (quran.com / sunnah.com) are stripped before synthesis, so this header reflects the exact text sent to the speech backend. If no Qur'anic verses or hadith were detected or no modifications were needed, this header will be absent.

# Text-to-Speech requires additional authorization and is not allowed by default.
# Pass stream=True to requests so it doesn't pre-buffer the body, then
# iterate over chunks. The first chunk arrives within ~1 s even for long
# inputs that would otherwise wait many seconds for the full synthesis.

import requests

url = "https://api.fanar.qa/v1/audio/speech"
headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
data = {
    "model": "Fanar-Aura-TTS-2",
    "input": "Hello! I hope you are having a wonderful day.",
    "voice": "Amelia",
    "response_format": "wav",
    "stream": True
}

with requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data, stream=True) as r:
    r.raise_for_status()
    with open("greeting.wav", "wb") as f:
        for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=8192):
            if chunk:
                f.write(chunk)

# Recommended for long files: `background: true` returns a job at once; poll it until it
# ends. Works for Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe (text) and Fanar-Aura-STT-LF-1 (any format).

import time

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.fanar.qa"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"}

with open("meeting.mp3", "rb") as f:
    response = requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/v1/audio/transcriptions",
        headers=HEADERS,
        files={"file": f},
        data={"model": "Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe", "background": "true"},
        timeout=300,  # the upload, not the transcription
    )
response.raise_for_status()
job = response.json()
print(f"job {job['id']}: {job['status']}")

while job["status"] in ("queued", "in_progress"):
    time.sleep(5)
    job = requests.get(
        f"{BASE_URL}/v1/audio/transcriptions/{job['id']}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=30
    ).json()

if job["status"] == "completed":
    print(job["result"]["text"])
else:  # failed or cancelled
    raise SystemExit(f"{job['status']}: {job['error']}")

get.description:
Transcribes live audio over a WebSocket, returning the text while the speaker talks.
Send the audio as binary frames (16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM, or 32-bit float with format=float32) and {"type": "input.end"} when it is over. The server replies with transcript.partial and transcript.final events (a segment ends at a pause in the speech), then session.ended with the full text and a reason: completed after input.end, max_duration, idle_timeout (no audio for 30 seconds) or upstream_error. A session lasts up to the maximum set for your API key (600 seconds by default), given in session.started. Connect from your server: browsers cannot set the Authorization header on a WebSocket.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model to use for live speech-to-text.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Sample format of the binary audio frames: int16 (16-bit PCM) or float32 (samples from -1.0 to 1.0). Audio is always 16 kHz, mono, little-endian.

parameters.name: disable_endpointing
parameters.description: When true, a segment does not end at a pause, only at input.end or after 60 seconds of audio. Use it for Qur'an recitation or other speech with long pauses.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the WebSocket is open, and the first event is session.started.

# Live streaming transcription requires the transcribe feature and is not allowed by default.
# pip install "websockets>=14"
import asyncio
import json
import wave

import websockets

# Add &disable_endpointing=true to keep a segment open through pauses (e.g. Qur'an recitation).
URL = "wss://api.fanar.qa/v1/audio/transcriptions/stream?model=Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"}
FRAME_SECONDS = 0.1  # 100 ms of audio per frame


async def send_audio(ws, path):
    # 16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM. A WAV file's frames are exactly what the stream takes.
    with wave.open(path, "rb") as wav:
        assert (wav.getframerate(), wav.getnchannels(), wav.getsampwidth()) == (16000, 1, 2)
        frames_per_chunk = int(16000 * FRAME_SECONDS)
        while chunk := wav.readframes(frames_per_chunk):
            await ws.send(chunk)                  # a binary frame is audio
            await asyncio.sleep(FRAME_SECONDS)    # paced like a live speaker
    await ws.send(json.dumps({"type": "input.end"}))  # no more audio


async def main():
    async with websockets.connect(URL, additional_headers=HEADERS) as ws:
        sender = None
        async for raw in ws:
            event = json.loads(raw)
            kind = event["type"]
            if kind == "session.started":
                print(f"session {event['id']}: up to {event['max_duration_seconds']}s")
                sender = asyncio.create_task(send_audio(ws, "sample.wav"))
            elif kind == "transcript.partial":
                # The open segment so far. Not cumulative: replace it in place.
                print(f"\r... {event['text']}", end="", flush=True)
            elif kind == "transcript.final":
                # That segment is done. Keep it; finals in segment order are the transcript.
                print(f"\r{event['text']}")
            elif kind == "session.expiring":
                print(f"\n{event['seconds_remaining']}s left in this session")
            elif kind == "error":
                print(f"\nerror {event['code']}: {event['message']}")
            elif kind == "session.ended":
                print(f"\nended ({event['reason']}): {event['text']}")
        if sender:
            sender.cancel()


asyncio.run(main())

# Live streaming transcription requires the transcribe feature and is not allowed by default.
# pip install "websockets>=14" sounddevice
import asyncio
import json
import signal

import sounddevice as sd
import websockets

# The microphone gives 32-bit float samples, so the stream is told format=float32.
# Add &disable_endpointing=true to keep a segment open through pauses (e.g. Qur'an recitation).
URL = "wss://api.fanar.qa/v1/audio/transcriptions/stream?model=Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe&format=float32"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"}


async def main():
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    audio = asyncio.Queue()
    stop = asyncio.Event()
    loop.add_signal_handler(signal.SIGINT, stop.set)  # Ctrl-C finishes the input, not the program

    def on_audio(indata, frames, time, status):
        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(audio.put_nowait, bytes(indata))

    async def send(ws):
        # 1600 samples = 100 ms per frame, 16 kHz mono 32-bit float in [-1, 1].
        with sd.RawInputStream(samplerate=16000, channels=1, dtype="float32",
                               blocksize=1600, callback=on_audio):
            while not stop.is_set():
                try:
                    chunk = await asyncio.wait_for(audio.get(), timeout=0.5)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    continue
                await ws.send(chunk)

        started = json.loads(await ws.recv())
        deadline = loop.time() + started["max_duration_seconds"]
        print(f"Speak now (up to {started['max_duration_seconds']}s). Ctrl-C to finish.")
        sender = asyncio.create_task(send(ws))
        async for raw in ws:
            event = json.loads(raw)
            left = max(0, int(deadline - loop.time()))
            if event["type"] == "transcript.partial":
                print(f"\r[{left:>3}s] {event['text']}", end="", flush=True)
            elif event["type"] == "transcript.final":
                print(f"\r[{left:>3}s] {event['text']}")
            elif event["type"] == "session.expiring":
                print(f"\n{event['seconds_remaining']}s left - wrap up")
            elif event["type"] == "session.ended":
                print(f"\nended ({event['reason']}): {event['text']}")
        stop.set()
        await asyncio.gather(sender, return_exceptions=True)

# Holds one connection for the whole run; for a stream that survives drops, use
# "Python - background + stream". Take the result from the `report` chunk.
#
#   {"progress": {"message": {"en": ..., "ar": ...}}}   a pass completed
#   {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": "..."}}]}        prose, token by token
#   {"report": {...}}                                   the finished report
#   {"choices": [{"finish_reason": "stop", ...}]}       usage + references
#   data: [DONE]                                        end of stream

import json

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.fanar.qa"
API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"


def deep_research_stream(topic, depth="standard", web_search=False):
    """Yield (kind, payload) for each event; kind is progress|delta|report|done."""
    with requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/v1/sadiq/deep-research",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        json={
            "model": "Fanar-Sadiq-2",
            "input": topic,
            "depth": depth,
            "web_search": web_search,
            "stream": True,
        },
        stream=True,
        timeout=1800,
    ) as response:
        response.raise_for_status()

        for line in response.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
            if not line or not line.startswith("data: "):
                continue
            data = line[len("data: "):].strip()
            if data == "[DONE]":
                break
            chunk = json.loads(data)

            if "error" in chunk:
                raise RuntimeError(chunk["error"].get("message", "stream error"))
            if "progress" in chunk:
                yield "progress", chunk["progress"]["message"]["en"]
                continue
            if "report" in chunk:
                yield "report", chunk["report"]
                continue

            choice = (chunk.get("choices") or [{}])[0]
            if choice.get("finish_reason"):
                yield "done", chunk
            elif choice.get("delta", {}).get("content"):
                yield "delta", choice["delta"]["content"]


report = None
for kind, payload in deep_research_stream("The importance of seeking knowledge in Islam"):
    if kind == "progress":
        print(f"... {payload}")
    elif kind == "report":
        report = payload
    elif kind == "done":
        # `metadata` carries the run facts (depth, elapsed_seconds, total_sources,
        # web_search_used). `usage` is often absent on this endpoint -- do not rely on it.
        print(f"\nmetadata: {payload.get('metadata')}")

if report:
    print(report["title"])
    print(report.get("markdown") or report["overview"])

import time

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.fanar.qa"

        "input": "The importance of seeking knowledge in Islam",
        "depth": "standard",
        "background": True,
    },
    timeout=30,
)
response.raise_for_status()
job = response.json()
print(f"job {job['id']}: {job['status']}")

while job["status"] in ("queued", "in_progress"):
    time.sleep(10)
    job = requests.get(
        f"{BASE_URL}/v1/sadiq/deep-research/{job['id']}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=30
    ).json()
    # progress_pct can sit at 100 for a while: the last sentences are still being
    # checked before the job completes.
    print(f"{job['status']} {job['progress_pct']}%")

if job["status"] == "completed":
    report = job["result"]
    print(report["title"])
    print(report.get("markdown") or report["overview"])
elif job["status"] == "incomplete":
    print("stopped by a content filter:", job["incomplete_details"]["reason"])
else:  # failed or cancelled
    raise SystemExit(f"{job['status']}: {job['error']}")

x-codeSamples.source:
import time

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.fanar.qa"
API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"
JOB_ID = "YOUR_JOB_ID"  # the `id` from the create call, also its X-Id header


def wait_for(job_id, every=10):
    while True:
        response = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/v1/sadiq/deep-research/{job_id}",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"},
            timeout=30,
        )
        if response.status_code == 404:
            # Unknown, created under a different access, or past its 24-hour retention.
            raise SystemExit("no such job")
        response.raise_for_status()
        job = response.json()
        if job["status"] not in ("queued", "in_progress"):
            return job
        print(f"{job['status']} {job['progress_pct']}% (attempt {job['attempt']})")
        time.sleep(every)


job = wait_for(JOB_ID)
if job["status"] == "completed":
    print(job["result"]["title"])
elif job["status"] == "incomplete":
    # The output was stopped by a content filter; there is no result.
    print("incomplete:", job["incomplete_details"]["reason"])
elif job["status"] == "cancelled":
    print("cancelled by", job["cancel_source"])
else:  # failed
    print("failed:", job["error"]["code"], job["error"]["message"])

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for the model.

created.title: Created
created.description: The creation timestamp of the model.

model.description:

file.title: File

format.description:
The format of the speaker turns.
- `json`: The turns as JSON, with the audio's length and the number of speakers.
- `rttm`: The turns as RTTM text, the format diarization tools score.

num_speakers.title: Num Speakers
num_speakers.description: The exact number of speakers, if you know it, for example 2 for an interview. It gives better results than letting the model guess, and takes precedence over `max_speakers`.

max_speakers.title: Max Speakers
max_speakers.description: The most speakers to look for (10 if not set). Raise it for recordings with many speakers, such as news bulletins or panels.

model.description:
The model to use for the speech-to-text.
- `Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe`: Any length, a short clip or a long recording, transcribed whole for accuracy. Text, or with `diarize: true` speaker-labelled `json` or `srt`; use `background: true` for files too long to wait for.
- `Fanar-Aura-STT-1` (deprecated): Short audio clips (up to 20–30 seconds).
- `Fanar-Aura-STT-LF-1` (deprecated): Long-form transcription with subtitles or timed segments.

file.title: File
file.description: The audio blob to transcribe. Up to 100 MB for `Fanar-Aura-STT-LF-1` and 100 MB for `Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe`, or less where your API key sets a lower limit.

format.description:
The format of the transcribed text. `Fanar-Aura-STT-1` supports `text` only; `Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe` supports `text`, or `json` and `srt` with `diarize: true`.
- `text`: Plain text format.
- `srt`: SubRip Subtitle format.
- `json`: JSON format with detailed transcription data.

background.title: Background
background.description: Run as a background job and return it at once (`Fanar-Aura-STT-LF-1` and `Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe` only). Use it for files too long to finish within a request.

diarize.title: Diarize
diarize.description: Label each segment with its speaker: who said what (`Fanar-3.0-Aura-Transcribe` only, with `format` `json` or `srt`). Speakers are numbered in order of appearance in the recording (`Speaker 00`, `Speaker 01`, ...). It adds a diarization pass, so long files may need `background: true`.

num_speakers.title: Num Speakers
num_speakers.description: With `diarize: true`: the exact number of speakers, if you know it, for example 2 for an interview. It gives better speaker labels than letting the model guess, and takes precedence over `max_speakers`.

max_speakers.title: Max Speakers
max_speakers.description: With `diarize: true`: the most speakers to look for (10 if not set). Raise it for recordings with many speakers, such as news bulletins or panels.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the personalized voice to be created.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: The audio sample to create the personalized voice. Only WAV format is accepted.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: The transcript of the audio sample.

A call the model asks the caller to make, in the OpenAI shape (Fanar-2.0-Tools). The other

with its result.

model.description: The model to use for the completion. For the Fanar-Sadiq and Fanar-Sadiq-2 models, the following LLM parameters are not used.

enable_thinking.title: Enable Thinking
enable_thinking.description: Whether to enable the thinking role in the conversation. This only applies if the model supports it. Currently, only the Fanar-C-2-27B model supports this parameter with additional authorization.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: A penalty for how much new tokens should avoid repeating existing ones.

logit_bias.title: Logit Bias
logit_bias.description: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

logprobs.title: Logprobs
logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not.

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens toreturn at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.

n.title: N
n.description: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based onwhether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood totalk about new topics.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Whether to stream back partial progress as tokens are generated.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: The sampling temperature, where 0.0 means deterministic output.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Controls the cumulative probability of the top tokens to consider.

best_of.title: Best Of
best_of.description: Number of output sequences that are generated from the prompt.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Controls the number of top tokens to consider.

min_p.title: Min P
min_p.description: Represents the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token.

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty
repetition_penalty.description: A penalty for repeating the same tokens in the generated output.

length_penalty.title: Length Penalty
length_penalty.description: Penalizes sequences based on their length. Used in beam search.

early_stopping.title: Early Stopping
early_stopping.description: Controls the stopping condition for beam-based methods.

stop_token_ids.title: Stop Token Ids
stop_token_ids.description: List of tokens that stop the generation when they are generated.

ignore_eos.title: Ignore Eos
ignore_eos.description: Whether to ignore the EOS token and continue generating tokens after the EOS token is generated.

min_tokens.title: Min Tokens
min_tokens.description: Minimum number of tokens to generate per output sequence before EOS or stop_token_ids can be generated.

skip_special_tokens.title: Skip Special Tokens
skip_special_tokens.description: Whether to skip special tokens in the output.

spaces_between_special_tokens.title: Spaces Between Special Tokens
spaces_between_special_tokens.description: Whether to add spaces between special tokens in the output.

truncate_prompt_tokens.title: Truncate Prompt Tokens
truncate_prompt_tokens.description: If set to an integer k, will use only the last k tokens from the prompt

prompt_logprobs.title: Prompt Logprobs
prompt_logprobs.description: Number of log probabilities to return per prompt token.

exclude_sources.description: List of sources to exclude from the Fanar-Sadiq model. Accepts predefined source names or values starting with 'digital_seerah'.

filter_sources.description: List of sources to filter from the Fanar-Sadiq model. Accepts predefined source names or values starting with 'digital_seerah'.

restrict_to_islamic.description: When enabled for Fanar-Sadiq model, only Islamic content prompts will be accepted. Non-Islamic content will be rejected.

persona.description: Custom persona that controls the assistant's voice and identity for the Fanar-Sadiq model. Free-form text; only supported for Fanar-Sadiq.
